latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Video Generator AI YouTube (v1.0.0)
- Generate 60-second YouTube-ready videos with voiceover, visuals, and captions from your script in under 2 minutes.
- Supports uploads of TXT, DOCX, MP4, MOV (files up to 200MB).
- Simple, automated workflow: upload text or video, give instructions, and receive a 1080p MP4 for download.
- Includes token authentication flow and automated onboarding with 100 free credits for new users.
- Provides session management, cloud video rendering, export handling, and guidance for error responses.
